verificationSet: frozen top 10 from predeclared B1 global top-1% attribution

corporateActions: Legacy Oasis common equity was canceled on 2020-11-19 under the Chapter 11 plan.
Former common holders received warrants to acquire reorganized Oasis common, while 100% of new common was issued to allowed note claims.
The later OAS common price therefore represents reorganized successor common rather than one-for-one continuity of the entry common share.
Arlington Asset Investment Corp. changed its NYSE Class A common ticker from AI to AAIC effective 2020-10-26.
By December 2020 the ticker AI represented C3.ai, Inc. Class A common stock, a different issuer/security.
An Arlington entry holder continued in AAIC and did not receive C3.ai shares; same-ticker AI entry-to-exit chaining crosses issuer identity.
Overstock common remained the same listed OSTK common security through the canonical window.
A Series A-1 preferred digital dividend was distributed on 2020-05-19 to eligible common holders; it is additional holder consideration but does not replace/cancel the common security.
events.note: The canonical common-price return is security-continuous but is not a total-return measure including the separately distributed preferred asset.

corporateActions: The old Spark Networks, Inc. combination closed on 2017-11-02.
Each 10 shares of old Spark Networks, Inc. common entitled the holder to one newly issued Spark Networks SE ADS.
The successor ADS continued under LOV, so one old share cannot be naively chained one-for-one to one later LOV ADS.
events.holderBasisNote: Using the frozen entry open 1.26 and the implied canonical exit price 15.00, ten entry shares cost 12.60 and converted to one ADS worth 15.00 at exit, approximately +19.05% before benchmark/other adjustments rather than +1090.48%.

corporateActions: Trovagene changed its corporate name to Cardiff Oncology and ticker to CRDF effective 2020-05-08, before the canonical entry.
Cardiff Oncology, CIK 0001213037, remained the CRDF registrant through the exit window.
TheStreet announced a cash acquisition by Maven on 2019-06-12, inside the return window.
The merger did not close until 2019-08-07, after the canonical 2019-06-17 exit, so the TST common security remained outstanding at exit.
The Noble Energy acquisition agreement was entered into on 2017-01-13, after the canonical 2016-10-04 exit.
The transaction completed on 2017-04-24, also after the exit.
Digital Turbine common was registered and traded as APPS during the canonical window.
A 2020-09-15 Form 8-K, immediately before the exit, still identifies the same registrant/common security as APPS on Nasdaq.
The issuer later changed its name to Alto Ingredients, but PEIX remained the common-stock ticker through 2021-01-31.
The new ticker ALTO began 2021-02-01, after the canonical 2021-01-11 exit.
Turtle Beach effected a 1-for-4 reverse split after the close on 2018-04-06 and began trading split-adjusted on 2018-04-09.
The research market backfill explicitly requests Alpaca adjustment=all and stores adjusted OHLC with is_adjusted=true and adjustment_basis=alpaca-adjustment-all.
The split therefore does not create a one-share continuity error in the canonical adjusted market series.

nextGateReason: At least two frozen top events are security-discontinuous and one is transformed with a non-1:1 exchange ratio. A general cohort-wide correction rule must be frozen before any B1 recomputation.
